constraints.name: k_even
constraints.description: The parameter k must be an even integer.

constraints.name: placeholder_replacement_all
constraints.description: Every occurrence of the placeholder '?' in the string s must be replaced by either '0' or '1'.
constraints.formal: For every i, if s[i] = '?' then s'[i] ∈ {'0','1'}, else s'[i] = s[i]

constraints.name: final_string_k_balanced
constraints.description: After replacing all placeholders, the resulting bitstring must be k-balanced: every contiguous substring of length k contains exactly k/2 zeros and k/2 ones.
